title: Gilded PvP Pack
description: A couple nice textures for Crystal PvP, with a gilded aesthetic. Note: this is not made fully by me, but the owner didn't upload it so here it is for you guys to see and maybe use.
body:
A couple nice textures for Crystal PvP, with a gilded aesthetic. Note: this is not made fully by me, but the owner didn't upload it so here it is for you guys to see and maybe use. So far, the pack has custom:
- End Crystal Textures
- Respawn Anchor Textures
- Glowstone Textures
- Totem Textures
- Ender Pearl Textures
- Golden Apple Textures.

Thanks for checking out the pack!
